extensions.tokenSyntax: DESIGN.md frontmatter owns native QML binding tokens. Values are evaluated in Panel.qml context, not CSS; root.systemFontFamily is bar.fontFamily with Style.font.family fallback.

heading.purpose: Noto Kufi Arabic heading or live English system family.

body.purpose: Noto Sans Arabic or live English system family; next/current prayer names are bold.

body-small.purpose: Dates, Qibla, source/refresh and integrated countdown.

caption.purpose: Small native form labels and explanations.

prayer-time.purpose: Live system font, right-aligned and unmirrored in the time column.

next-time.purpose: Modest bold emphasis within the timeline; no display hero.

native.previewPolicy: Native QML sources replace HTML/CSS approximations; no HTML detector or mobile-platform audit is applicable.
native.layout: Fitted 400-unit preferred content width with vertical overflow; no web breakpoints.
native.motion: Focused views switch immediately. No custom settings opacity/reveal animation is defined in the current Panel.qml.
native.elevation: No local timeline shadows or glow; tonal wash, hairlines and native shell framing provide structure.
native.scope: Reviewed timeline popover, its focused views and bar. The separate adhan overlay in Service.qml uses Style.font.family for English and Noto Sans Arabic for Arabic; its layout was not included in the supplied view captures.

uiConcept.kind: Approved generated concept C; illustrative data, not a screenshot

cover.kind: Approved generated blue-hour skyline; OpenAI built-in ImageGen; exact prompt embedded in PNGs

screenshots.kind: Direct grim capture of running native plugin on 2026-11-06 at 1.25 display scale, cropped to popup border; provenance embedded in PNGs

provenance.comparison: Code-led native adaptation and visual inspection; no measured concept-diff result is claimed.

components.name: Prayer row
components.description: Chronological entry with square marker, flexible name and fixed unmirrored time column.

components.name: Next prayer row
components.description: Taller accent row containing the countdown; an explicit tomorrow label is appended after Isha.

components.name: Qibla and refresh
components.description: Flexible Qibla label beside source/refresh; busy, offline and refresh-error states.

components.name: Destination actions
components.description: Three equal-width native buttons open Location, Reminders or Settings; focused views provide Back to timetable.

components.name: Location
components.description: Country filter, offline city presets and city search; extra location controls are collapsed initially.

components.name: Prayer settings
components.description: Online tables, method suggestion, time correction, method, Asr and Hijri controls.

components.name: Reminders
components.description: Delivery mode and at-adhan/advance toggles, with conditional lead-minute adjustment.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Native minus/plus actions surrounding a centered bold value.

components.name: Bar widget
components.description: Live-font bar label with native imminent state, contextual tooltip and three mouse actions.

narrative.overview: A chronological prayer list is the main composition. The next prayer expands just enough to contain its countdown, with the exact start aligned to the other entries. The native panel follows live Omarchy colors and English typography, retains Noto Arabic families and separates Location, Reminders and Settings into direct destinations.
keyCharacteristics: One integrated countdown inside the next prayer row
Live desktop colors and English/numeric typography
Noto Arabic families and mirrored reading layout
Thin timeline, square markers and flat native controls
Direct, distinct Location, Reminders and Settings views

rules.name: The Desktop Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep live bindings; the review screenshot palette is one Omarchy theme. There is no user-facing appearance switch.

rules.name: The Numeric Rule
rules.body: Keep exact prayer times right-aligned and unmirrored. Mirror Arabic composition and label alignment without replacing the English/numeric system font.

dos: Do keep next start and countdown together, with an explicit tomorrow row at the day boundary.
Do follow live desktop colors and English/numeric fonts, retaining Noto Arabic headings/body.
Do preserve distinct destinations and initially hidden advanced location controls.
Do retain native Qt Quick controls, keyboard focus and Omarchy scale bindings.
Do distinguish approved generated concepts and blue-hour cover from actual desktop screenshots and preserve their provenance.
donts: Don’t restore a fixed emerald palette, an appearance selector, oversized hero numerals, a separate countdown card or a ring.
Don’t duplicate settings across views or expose all advanced location controls on entry.
Don’t present illustrative concept times or campaign artwork as a product screenshot.
Don’t describe the native Linux panel as web or mobile, or claim measured concept-diff results.
